newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche's Breuer - German bourse air thin.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche's Breuer - German bourse air thin.

text.p: Rolf Breuer, the new chief executive of Deutsche Bank AG, on Thursday evening warned investors in the German stock market that the market was at heady heights and advised caution.

"The air is getting thin at current levels...and this in an atmosphere where there is an unknown political situation in France and uncertainty about U.S. interest rates...," Breuer told Frankfurt business journalists.
"We are at heady heights. I would advise caution."
Germany's 30-share DAX IBIS index ended computer trading on Thursday at 3,737.16 points, up 65.29 on the day and just marginally below a new intraday high of 3,739.28.
